opening.text: I've got this pain that came on slowly. It feels tender and burning, and I'd rate it about a 5 out of 10. I've also been coughing up blood and I have a fever. My nose is either stuffy or running clear. By the way, I smoke cigarettes, and I've been around someone with similar symptoms in the past two weeks. I also go to or work in a daycare.
